title: Undergraduate Thesis
summary: An analysis of the racetrack problem as a heuristic search benchmark
detailsHTML: Formalized and evaluated the racetrack problem for heuristic search benchmarks. Defined domain dynamics, variants (New Hampshire, Airbag), and proposed two novel heuristics. Provided proofs of admissibility and consistency. Benchmarked with A* and Weighted A*.
